newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares fall 1.71 pct on political tension.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares fall 1.71 pct on political tension.

text.p: Istanbul shares lost an average 1.71 percent in thin trade on Monday as fears over the fate of the Islamist-led government persisted despite deputy PM Tansu Ciller's remarks that the coalition would survive.
The IMKB National-100 closed 25 points lower at 1,441 after moving between 1,434 and 1,478. It had dived 4.3 percent in two trading days last week on escalating political tension.
Several brokers expect the index to drift in a narrow range at above the 1,420 support.
"The market may edge higher on selective buys, but it looks as though the narrow trade will continue until the political picture is settled," said Huseyin Istanbullu from Meksa securities.
"The index will move between 1,420 and 1,500 until there is a positive (political) result," he added.
Trade volume shrank to 9.55 trillion lira ($70.6 million) from Friday's 13.02 trillion ($97.1 million).
Brokers said decreasing trade volume helped to prevent sharper falls.
